integrity: A self-contained all-parameter algebraic proof is supplied. Separate exact rational checks cover finite samples; no computation is claimed to establish universality. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact one-step inverse-fiber classification for positive a,c only; no claims about periodic orbits, attractors or other parameter signs. General inverse theorems cover the homeomorphism component of the classification. Priority of the complete object-specific table is provisional.
title: Complete inverse-valence phase diagram of a four-quadrant absolute-value map
